subject: StellarPay discovery recap and timing — checking in
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Victor Chen <v.chen@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: StellarPay discovery recap and next steps

Hi Victor — thanks for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:

What we heard:
- Primary goal: reduce LLM inference cost by ~40% while maintaining 95th%-tile latency under 300ms for interactive flows.
- Key workloads: payment intent classification (short-context) and customer support summarization (longer context).
- Constraints: PCI-adjacent data handling, SOC2 evidence required, procurement prefers a single annual contract.

Proposed next steps (from Redwood):
1) I’ll share a mutual action plan (attached) that maps deliverables, owners, and dates.
2) Sergio can put together a short environment/deploy notes doc (networking ports, certs, VPC options) if needed.
3) Lauren will sketch a 30/60/90 onboarding estimate for ramping Dedicated capacity.
4) You confirm the procurement contact and target decision window (ideal and fallback).

Attachments: StellarPay_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan)

Can you confirm the procurement email and whether the week of 3/8 still works for target decision? If you prefer, we can do a 10-min follow-up next week to go over the MAP.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing this.

—
Dev Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: StellarPay discovery recap and next steps — quick internal alignment (no reply from Victor)

Team — following up internally. I haven’t heard back from Victor after the recap (sent Tue 2/10). Before I bump, want to align on what we surface and who owns what so the bump is crisp and helpful. Suggested plan:

- Sergio: can you finalize a 1-page SE note (network + on-prem/VPC checklist + any showstopper items) by EOD Mon? Label it: se-arch-deploy-notes.md.
- Lauren: can you produce a rough onboarding cost & timeline (30/60/90) as a one-pager? I’ll attach it to the bump.
- Hannah: if the prospect asks for a pricing concession to accelerate, can I offer a one-time pilot credit (up to $10k) or should we leave that to leadership approval?

Context: Victor flagged procurement involvement and a target decision window around early March. My objective with the bump is to confirm timing / procurement contact and offer a short 10-min slot to remove any blocking questions — not to re-open a technical deep-dive.

If you have alternate suggestions or a different cadence for re-contact, call it out — I’ll incorporate and send the bump Monday.

—
Dev

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 08:43:00 -0800
Subject: Checking in — quick question on timing for StellarPay (10-min)

Hi Victor — hope you’re well. I just wanted to check in on timing for the decision window you mentioned on our call. Quick note: I’ve attached a 1-page onboarding estimate and an SE checklist in case that helps speed things up on your side.

If it’s helpful, I’m happy to do a 10-minute call this week to answer any procurement/security questions — I can bring Sergio for technical clarifications and Lauren for onboarding. Are you available for a short squeeze call? A few openings: Wed 2/18 11:00–11:30 PT, Thu 2/19 09:00–09:30 PT.

We’d also be open to offering a small pilot credit if that materially helps schedule/prioritize evaluation — we can discuss specifics on the call. No obligation — just trying to remove friction.

Thanks —
Dev

From: Victor Chen <v.chen@stellarpay.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Checking in — quick question on timing for StellarPay (10-min)

Dev — apologies for the slow reply; we’ve been juggling internal timelines. Quick update:
- We remain interested; team is reviewing MAP and the estimates.
- Procurement expects a prioritized vendor list week of 3/8; they will reach out to shortlisted vendors for formal quotes.
- Security will want a copy of your SOC2 report and the brief SE checklist you mentioned.

Can you send the SOC2 and the onboarding estimate together? Also include the procurement contact email you mentioned so I can loop them in. If you can have those docs over by next Tue (2/24), that’d be helpful. Otherwise procurement will reach out in the 3/8 window.

Thanks — Victor
Director, Platform Engineering | StellarPay
